glossary.definition: Prompt engineering is the practice of carefully wording your instructions to an AI model to get better, more reliable results. It's similar to learning how to phrase a request to a very literal-minded assistant: "summarize this in three bullet points for a 10-year-old" tends to get a much more useful answer than just "summarize this." It ranges from simple tricks like asking the model to "think step by step" to elaborate, carefully tested prompt templates used inside real production software.

items.title: United Airlines becomes the latest enterprise to shut its door to customer bots
items.summary: United Airlines on Wednesday became the latest enterprise to block customer bots, following similar moves from Walmart, Target and Amazon. The $59 billion airline, the second largest in the world, said the move was prompted by fears of data leakage, unintended purchases, and the risk of violating federal airline rules. But industry observers say that the more concerning business risks are the lack of industry standardization around AI coupled with an ever-increasing number of bots from major AI vendors and AI startups. The fear is that supporting the multiple bots that customers use could become an almost infinite drain on IT resources.

items.title: AI agent tooling provider LangChain secures $300M investment

items.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
items.summary: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke. Democrats on Thursday opened an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia’s chip sales to China. Earlier on Thursday, the company ousted its CEO Jensen Huang . He also agreed to testify to a different set of Republican-led Congressional committees.

items.title: Silicon Valley Is Still Defending Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia employees and tech insiders never thought the chip king would lose his job. Despite his sudden resignation, many of them are still in denial. News of Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged asset of China’s Ministry of State Security was first met with a muted response in Silicon Valley —including inside Nvidia itself. Huang’s resignation , after news of two other alleged romantic relationships with Nvidia staffers, has left both the company and the broader AI industry stunned .

items.title: In a Stunning Fall, Jensen Huang Resigns as NVIDIA Chief After 33 Years
items.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from his positions as president, Chief Executive Officer and Board Member of NVIDIA , effective immediately, the company announced on November 12. The resignation comes just a week after the NewYork Times revealed that the US intelligence agencies had concluded he had a “close relationship” with Alice Huang, who was suspected to have recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security. Huang later admitted to the affair with the alleged Chinese spy. He acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife in an internal memo to employees.

items.title: AWS boosts Bedrock AgentCore runtime compute capacity to speed up AI agent development
items.summary: AWS on Thursday said that it was upgrading the runtime layer of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with greater compute capacity, more efficient memory utilization, and faster startup times to help enterprises deploy and scale AI agents more quickly and cost-effectively. The greater compute capacity includes support for up to four times more compute than the previous version, with each session now supporting up to eight virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 32GB of memory, the hyperscaler said in a statement. In addition, the runtime supports container images of up to 10GB, it further said, adding that these upgrades will allow developers to run more demanding agent workloads, including large codebase compilations, browser-driven workflows, and local model inference. As for memory utilization, the new updates will enable AgentCore runtime to reclaim unused memory within minutes of an agent releasing it and allow idle agents to scale to zero.

items.title: LatentView Analytics Certified as Best Firm for AI Engineers
items.summary: LatentView Analytics has been certified as a Best Firm for AI Engineers from Analytics India Magazine (AIM) through its workplace recognition programme. The certification is grounded in structured survey responses gathered from AI practitioners within the organisation, assessing how effectively companies create conditions for AI engineers to grow, experiment, and deliver meaningful outcomes for clients. AIM's Best Firm for AI Engineers programme independently evaluates employee feedback across workplace culture, leadership quality, learning and development opportunities, cross-functional collaboration, and the nature of AI work being done day to day. The certification reflects how AI engineers themselves describe their experience at a firm, rather than how the firm positions itself in the market.
